messages.content:
You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
In Figure 1, which statement best describes the characteristics and implications of the pulmonary nodule observed in the chest X-ray of the 5-year-old boy with dysphagia?
A) The nodule is located in the right lower lobe, is poorly defined, and suggests a malignant process due to irregular borders.
B) The nodule is located in the right upper lobe, is well-defined, and suggests a benign process due to its homogeneous appearance and lack of associated pleural effusion.
C) The nodule is located in the left lower lobe, is well-defined, and suggests an infectious process due to adjacent air-trapping.
D) The nodule is located in the right upper lobe, is poorly defined, and suggests an inflammatory process due to adjacent air-trapping.
E) The nodule is located in the left upper lobe, is well-defined, and suggests a benign process due to its size and position.
F) The nodule is located in the right upper lobe, is well-defined, and suggests a malignant process due to its associated air-trapping.
